result.title: Agentic Large Language Models
result.summary: Large language models (LLMs) have taken the world by storm. Their ability to communicate with us in our own language, and to reason about our world, has made them a favorite tool for writing, answering questions, and much more. Their answers already influence our decisions and our actions. What would happen if LLMs themselves could act in the world directly? What would happen if LLMs could interact with each other? Agentic LLMs combine the power of large language models with the ability to act in the real world. In this book we will discuss how agentic LLMs work, how they act, how they interact, and what this means for us, as users.

AI.brief_summary: 这是一本 472 页的教科书，系统梳理 agentic LLM 如何行动、智能体之间如何交互，以及这对使用者的意义。
AI.relevance_reason: 书中关于 LLM 主动行动与多智能体交互的框架，可能为 LVR 中「何时获取视觉证据、何时停止、如何评价」这类决策问题提供概念参照，但需核查是否触及内部状态与计算分配。
